The maxilla grows downwards and forwards through a combination of sutural growth at its articulations with other bones (including the zygomaticomaxillary sutures) and surface remodeling. Growth at these sutures contributes to the overall increase in the dimensions (height, length, and width) of the maxilla.
D) 'The intermaxillary suture closes about eight years postnatally'. This statement is incorrect. The intermaxillary (midpalatal) suture typically remains open and active for growth much longer than 8 years postnatally, often until late adolescence or early adulthood.
